question: Under what condition must a teaching be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year?
premises: A teaching is marked as something to be given.
The recipient is one who has been previously accomplished.
The recipient has been tested for the duration of one year.
inference: Transmission is restricted to a previously accomplished person who has passed a one-year test.
uncertainties: The nature of the test is not specified by this verse.
plain_english: This teaching is to be given only to one who was previously accomplished and has been tested for one year.
